  Changed the Lounge to a summer theme.
  Removed Valentine content; for example, contracts will no longer grant the skinbox. This means the Valentine 2025 skinbox is now considered legacy.
 Removed finger rewards from the Halloween 2024 contracts and the game.

notes.title: Survival Changes for Upcoming Wipe
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4326122/20d89d2ccfee236f173c83fa1edef89702f3ca09.png

Infestation: The New Beginning

As most of you know, we have been preparing significant changes for our game, specifically the Survival Game Mode. However, in this case, instead of innovating, we will be returning to the basics—what has worked in the past and what the community has been clamoring for!
 
Why is Survival being rebooted?
After several attempts at introducing new elements to Survival, your feedback has shown us what should remain unchanged in order to preserve the feeling we had when we played The War Z and Survivor Stories back in the day, and what can be kept from the recent changes. With that in mind, we have decided to recreate the game as it was—ambiance, loot rarity, mechanics, etc.—while retaining only the well-known and unquestionable improvements we've made since then. This, however, will be our starting point.

Post changes to it
From that point on, any changes we decide to make will be based solely on suggestions and polls from active Survival players. These polls will not lead to direct or immediate changes. One key consideration is that a 51% approval in polls will not be considered a sufficient majority. We need to assess whom the changes will affect and how they will impact those people. Therefore, we will require a larger margin for approval. We also aim to structure the polls in a straightforward manner, including an option like 'doesn't matter to me' to minimize the potential for larger groups to manipulate the results.

The goal of the new Survival mode is to ensure FUN for EVERYONE. Changes that could negatively impact a significant portion of the community, or that are controversial and divisive, may be rejected. 

Initial Plans for Survival
Our initial plans are based on the feedback we've received so far from the community, who are eager to experience a true Survival mode, reminiscent of what Infestation/The War Z once was.

Seasons
We will structure the game mode into seasons, following a classic seasonal system with wipes occurring at set intervals to keep the game fresh and the community engaged. Our initial plan is for seasons to last 6 to 9 months, but we need to assess whether that works for most players. To determine the ideal season length, we will run the first season without a fixed end date. This will allow us to observe how far players progress into the endgame and how long it takes before they no longer have anything left to do.

Maps
We will have only ONE map available at all times, and the same map will be used across both Official and Private Servers. There may be maps for specific TEMPORARY events with different rules, etc. Missions will also be available throughout the season, though at the beginning, they will be more limited. There will be fewer missions initially, as they can greatly impact player progression. To achieve the right balance, we need to observe how the game mode feels without excessive 'boosts' to progression and the economy.

Skins
Skins are a very controversial aspect of Survival. There are a few things we need to address, but we believe we’ve found a fair balance.

First, let’s talk about clan skins. Clans with existing clan skins can request to have them re-added to the new Survival mode. This can only be done by the current clan leader, who must have a character and clan created in the Game Mode.

Second, and most importantly: Skins are optional! While everyone knows you can choose not to use skins, that doesn’t stop others from using them. With that in mind, we’ve introduced a new system that allows you to disable all item skins in your game.

So, even if a player has a skin equipped, you won’t see it if you’ve enabled this option. However, if you enable the option and have a skin equipped yourself, even though you won’t see the skin, others who haven’t enabled this option will still be able to see it.

Loot
Another major change to the game mode will be the loot system. We’re going back to basics, removing many of the new gun additions (which we may reintroduce gradually later). The goal is to recreate the loot system as it was in the past, both in terms of rarity and placement, along with the quirky randomness we all remember. Who doesn’t recall finding a Mauser SP66 in a small-town supermarket?

However, on both Official and Private Servers, we’ve added a new system where the more players are connected to the server, the more loot will spawn. This system was introduced to ensure Private Servers don’t provide excessive advantages over Official Servers, while still making Private Servers appealing since you have the entire server to yourself. 

Zombies
Zombies are going back to basics, with Super Zombies being the only 'supers' available. They will no longer spawn 24/7 as they do now, but will only appear at certain times of the day (in-game time).

Additionally, we’ve introduced zombie variations during nighttime, along with an increased number of zombies. These nighttime zombies will also grant players more EXP and XP.

General Changes
In addition to the option to disable skins, we are also removing the option to disable shadows. With today’s hardware, shadows have minimal impact on performance, and the only reason to disable them is to make the game easier. We're going against that, as we want to maintain the element of surprise and encourage furtive, stealthy gameplay, especially in cities.

Another small but important change we've made is that, even if you have physics disabled, dropped items will no longer float and obstruct players' view.

Additionally, the overgrowth on buildings has been fixed and redone in certain areas to prevent abusive behavior.

Official Dates and Times

We will provide more details, including dates, times, and in-depth information, soon, so stay tuned!

Join our discussion on our discord server CLICK HERE

notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4326122/10c97c6062c1f4424255eca86c0a7a7b7fca47d5.jpg

Oceania Servers will be taken down. 

Dear players,
Due to the recent and upcoming increase in electricity prices for our provider, the prices for the servers have also been raised substantially in the last few months and will continue on the rise on the upcoming months. 
Since our contract renewal is coming up soon, we have made the decision to shut down our servers there for the foreseeable future as a way to prevent it from forcing us to also raise our prices in that specific region on October 1st, 2023. 
That, combined with the low demand of private servers in the region and the low amount of players at peak times in that region, we thought this would be the best course of action. 

For everyone who currently has a server in our Oceania server, you can request a move to any other region by submitting a ticket at http://support.playnewz.com/ 

Thank you for understanding

Hello Survivors!
On this patch we are bringing a few quality of life changes that have been both suggested and requested for a while and also some fixes for some smaller errors/bugs in the game. 

GENERAL CHANGES
CLAN MANAGEMENT UPDATE
With this update, we are introducing a rework for the clan section. It is a complete overhaul that will see more options on your clan. 
This has been asked for a while and though we wanted to work on this earlier, we had more pressing priorities. 
Clan creation was one of the first features brought under the original developer team in The War Z, but it was lackluster. We have put off doing this complete rework for some time as we didn't feel it was that urgent as, though it was too "plain", it worked for its purpose. 
However, we decided recently to start working on QOL changes such as this to make it even easier to understand for all players, new and old. 

Here are some of the changes made to it:
To access the new Clan Menu, you can find it here:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/a87ae828b0b02ce309cc9a99fcfe0df1cad15e08.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/1332e749eeb40ad61230b46d2065590d48900292.jpg

On the Customization menu, you will be able to edit your clan icon, name, description and tag color.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/7b388f8d949da030c70d7f0fa0ad091c1f98561a.jpg

Created an interactive Tutorial for Beginners. 
Though this might seem uninteresting for some players, after analyzing and collecting feedback from new players, we realized that this game is unique to a level that with no prior knowledge, it is easy to get lost on basic actions and objectives in the game. With that in mind, we created an interactive game tutorial made available for everyone to learn basic things and to help players get into the idea of the game in a more organized and logical way than just throwing them into a server with no instruction. 
Added more in-game tips
Updated the F1 Help screens.
Fixed a bug that would allow players to buy Premium even when they had Lifetime Premium.
Fixed an issue with the bus stop that would cause you to be stuck inside the structure after traveling. 
Added scrolling when you hover item names.

GENERAL CHANGES

USER INTERFACES AND MENUS:

GENERAL FIXES & CHANGES:

Skill Tree Rework

 We are releasing a new and more complete skill tree. This skill tree will require much more EXP but it will give you much more benefits. 
 Skills that have similar effects will have more levels and are grouped together, but you don't need to complete all level in order to progress. 
 There are some new skills that can be helpful as well. 
 To get a full skill tree you will need roughly 35 million EXP. However, to get the same skills as you currently have (as the previous full skill tree) you will need around the same. So choose where to place your skill points wisely. 
 All the skill points have been reset on all characters but your EXP is still there. 

OTHER CHANGES AND FIXES

 Fixed a bug that caused skinned items to have invalid/unused firemodes.
 Reworked the Weapon Restriction Option for Server owners. It's much simpler and more understandable.
 Optimized Zombies. Instead of lagging the whole game for you when loads of zombies die at once, the animation will be slowed down, that way the FPS will remain unaffected.
 Physics engine will now run at 60 fps, rather than 30. That means animations of server sided objects (grenades, zombies, items dropping) will be much smoother. 
 PhysX will now use more cores from your CPU (up to 4 instead of 2). This will be on higher end systems. This will improve overall performance when around many players/zombies/items.
 The grenade throwing system has been reworked for a smoother experience. 
 Updated the Netcode. Player movement should feel smoother now.
 Fixed a bug with some custom Riot Shields not having animation. 
 Fixed a major bug that caused servers with 50+ players to lag.
 Fixed a major bug with missions not loading correctly after a game updated.

	SUMMARY:
[olist]			New community Marketplace is available. It will only be available in GD items. 				Reworked the character screens to have a more dynamic one. 				"Open World" has been renamed to ARCADE. Open World was a very vast term and Survival is also technically an Open World game mode. 				Some minor changes were made to the UI to make them look cleaner and better.				Fixed the competitive store. 				We have made a major change to vehicles that should fix the flying car issue that some of you would experience. 				Added High Precision Servers. They have a new netcode that should improve trading shots against high ping players. This is still being tested.				Spawn Protection now glows less at night and more during the day. That makes it harder for enemies to spot you when you spawn in. 				Added a "PVP Leaderboard" section to the Community Tab. It will contain Weekly, Monthly and Seasonal leaderboards only affected by PVP servers. 				Added a RESET SEASON button to the Season Pass. It will show up AFTER you finish the season and will allow you to start it again. 				Added a spawn protection when reviving in Battle Royale. 				And much more! Don't forget to watch the DevBlog. 	[/olist]	
		https://www.youtube.com/embed/YeTiMYTNYzA
	 

	Full Patch Notes:

	GENERAL CHANGES

	USER INTERFACES AND MENUS:
			Open World has been renamed to Arcade.				Description of the different game modes has been changed.				We have reworked the character screen to a more dynamic one and they are unique to each game mode. 				Added a blur effect to the background when a new dialog pops up to make it easier to read.				ADDED A NEW TAB CALLED MARKET. IT'S AN OPEN MARKET WHERE PLAYERS CAN SELL AND BUY ITEMS DIRECTLY FROM OTHER PLAYERS. YOU CAN WATCH THE VIDEO ABOUT IT ABOVE!				Due to the addition of the MARKET, we have renamed the Marketplace to simply STORE.				Added a slider to the store to make it easier to switch amounts to buy.				Fixed the issue with the Competitive Store. It will now load properly.				Added a Notification system. For now, it will be used for the Market offers for the time being but it will be eventually implemented for everything else (server expiration, friend requests, subscription expiration, events, etc...)				Changed the default game background to a different renderer.				We are continuing to improve the scrolling on all screens.	
	GENERAL FIXES & CHANGES:
			The XP rewards on the PVE contracts has been increased from 1000 to 5000 each.				Medieval coins were removed from the inventories since the event is over.				Fixed a bug where deaths by traps and claymores wouldn't show properly on the death screen. 				"Ghost characters" do not show on the main menu Minimap anymore.				We have fixed the in-menu chat. It now should work properly. 				Fixed an issue where the player/zombie model would cause the vehicles to glitch through the ground and catapult them into space. 				Added a new server flag called High Precision Server. This is to address and test the new netcode to help bullet/hit registration. Fred goes into more details on it on the DevBlog. They will initially be activated on a few servers so we can see how it affects gameplay. As soon as we see it's as effective as hoped, they will be activated on all servers. 				Shooting Territory flags do not affect your KDR and rank anymore (they counted as missed shots).				Spawn Protection glow will change throughout the day (ingame time) to make it less "obvious". The darker it is, the less it will glow. This will help prevent people from spotting enemies as soon as they spawn at night.	
	 

	ITEM CHANGES

	MODELS:
			Fixed a texture issue on the White House LODs.				Regenerated physics of all armors and backpacks, they should not fall through the ground anymore.				Regenerated all the icons of the G36 and its skinned versions.	
	SKINS:
			Fixes									All Sig Sauer 556 skins have a skinned iron sight.										Fixed an issue withe MP5 Tech Skin.						
	 

	 

	OPEN WORLD

	NEW FEATURES:
			Added a new Leaderboard called PVP Leaderboards (you can see a little bit of it on the DevBlog above). They will show weekly and monthly/seasonal leaderboards exclusively for the PVP servers. This will give us more room for exclusive PVP server events with leaderboards, without having it compete with Open World maps.				Remember to read above about the new MARKET, fully controlled by players.

			Fixed a visual bug where when placing a bounty on a player, your GD wouldn't always decrease as soon as you placed it. 			Items from Helicopter Crashes will continue to be tweaked over time.				Items from secret rooms will continue to be tweaked over time. 				Items from the Slicer and Toxic zombies will continue to be tweaked over time.				Added new specialist contracts to the game, 5 PVP and 5 PVE ones.

	SUMMARY:

	This is a small hotfix to address some issues related to the Medieval Event and the maps. We are also still adjusting the issue related to zombies lagging players in places with high amounts of zombies. 

	 

	Full Patch Notes:

	GENERAL UPDATES
			Vehicles now apply a handbrake to forcefully slow down the vehicle after exiting it, this prevents vehicles from rolling away and desyncing.				Optimized Zombie Networking:									When zombies are far away from players or are part of larger hordes, their networking is limited to decrease the bandwidth used by their movement packets. This change has lowered the zombie network usage by 70%.										This optimization fixes an issue where people with really bad connections suffered from ping spikes when farming the airport.										When zombies are close to you, this system does not apply (unless there are more than 50 of them in a big horde around you).									Bear Traps & Claymores will now grant the kill to the owner who placed them.				Spawn protection will now sync properly when a plays has packet loss or high ping. 	
	MEDIEVAL EVENT

	SUMMARY:

Fixed objects around the maps.				We are tweaking the loot from Helicopter Crashes, Slicers and Secret Rooms live from now on. Any feedback is welcome.				We made a small change to the gun switching system. It now prevents abuse from it.				Added new contracts/missions with Slicer body parts.				Fixed an issue related to multiple zombies. This issue most likely is the main cause of the ping spikes on areas with many zombies.				Improved loot in some areas in both Open World and Survival.				Changed the way loot spawns in Secret Locked Rooms.	[/olist]
	 

	Full Patch Notes:

	GENERAL CHANGES

	USER INTERFACES AND MENUS:
			Made some small UI changes to have a cleaner look.				Whenever you pick up gear and attachments from the vault, it will no longer auto equip if its a superior one than you had on.				Oceania Servers have been removed from the Server List.				Added a protection on changing weapons that was easily abused. 				Reverted back a change that would cause your mouse to "escape" the Window when you had other menus open.				Fixed a bug where players were able to open the ingame store while dead.				Fixed a bug where you could use your "Taunt" command while typing in search bars in the GI or store.				Updated the Tutorial Windows in English, German and Portuguese.				Fixed a few issues in the French translation.	

	GENERAL FIXES:
			Fixed an issue with zombies that caused gathering too many of them at the same time. This SHOULD fix the ping spikes, but we will need broader testing. 				Made a few changes to physics on cars versus players that allowed players to abuse and enter areas they shouldn't.				You can open the "player list" (Tab Menu) while climbing up and down stairs.				When you pick up gear and attachments from the vault, it will no longer auto equip if it's a better one than you had on.				Fixed an issue that caused an error when gifting a friend character clothes on the marketplace. 	
	 

	ITEM CHANGES

	VEHICLES:
			Fixed a visual bug that would show the wrong durability on vehicles.				You are no longer able to repair vehicles when they're at 100%, so you won't waste repair kits. 				You are no longer able to refuel vehicles when they're at 100%, so you won't waste fuel.				Fixed an issue related to Player vs Vehicles physics that allowed players to glitch and abuse those glitches.				Normal Repair Kits will no longer repair vehicles with less than 25% durability left. For such cases a Premium Repair Kit will be required.	
	ZOMBIES:

Added two new unique items to the Slicer: Slicer Head and Slicer Blades. They can be acquired from Slicers and are needed for the Razer Blade contracts.

https://i.imgur.com/dKnBTGD.jpg

	Dear Community,

(Original Post: https://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/9023-patch-34/)

	As planned we are releasing patch 3.4 including fixes and improvements and the new Season Pass 04. Next to that we are also releasing the new Pulse skin collection. We are working hard on the next upcoming event although it's not just ready yet. Expect more information about that soon.

	 

	Now, without further ado, let's jump in to the patch notes:

	Overall Updates:

	GENERAL:
			Various new assets have been added to the game related to a future medieval themed event. More information about the Medieval 2020 event will follow soon.				Fixed an issue related to the recently added prefab spawn system. This is the system that for example controls the random appearing helicopter crashes on the maps. There was an issue that could cause the site not to spawn on private servers.				Fixed a bug that caused players not being able to pick up particular items in secrets rooms.	
	VEHICLES:
			Improved / Updated textures for the racer vehicle.				Fixed a bug causing cars to de-sync with clients.				You can no longer exit a vehicle while trying to glitch inside a locked area. People were using cars to glitch inside these rooms / areas. We'd like to remind all of you here that we have systems in place to ban players attempting this. Don't do it.	
	3D MODELS:
			Upscaled textures for the airfield control tower.	
	SPAWN SYSTEM:
			We are working hard on the current spawn system in the game. We have heared your feedback and made according improvements: players will no longer always spawn in the exact location of the player spawn, but instead  spawn in a close area around that particular spawn. This will always be random. We hope aim to improve the current situation.	
	 

	Medieval 2020 Event:

	The Medieval 2020 event will not start just yet, so hold on! With this update we are already teasing some of the content for you guys.
			The vault NPC textures have been updated to fit the Medieval 2020 event style.				The trading lounge has been updated to the Medieval 2020 variant.	
	We hope you are all as excited for this event as we are. Stay tuned for more soon!

	https://i.imgur.com/zkiJwJt.png

	https://i.imgur.com/7ixzRAB.png

	(More pictures here: https://imgur.com/a/w49ITgz)

	 

	Season Pass 04:

	In this update we are releasing Season Pass 04. The pass will directly be available after the update in the in-game marketplace for 2000 GC. A lot of new, unique content has been created and added to the game for this Season Pass and overall we are very happy with the result.
	
	https://i.imgur.com/RtfgG8i.jpg

	Based on your feedback we have created Season Pass 04 and there is a couple of things that we'd like to address and explain:
[olist]			This Season Pass will be available and over a period of time that is over 2 months. It will end on July 31, at 12:00 PM (CET) 2020. The reason for this length is so that everyone has enough time to potentially finish it and claim all the rewards from all the levels.
		 				The levels and XP needed per level hasn't changed compared to previous passes. We are overall pretty satisfied with the current level and XP amounts so there is not really a reason (yet) to change anything around this subject.
		 				New exclusive content has been added for the Season Pass 04. This goes from unique sprays and taunts all the way to skins. A lot of next-level looking skins have been added and will only be available through the season pass. (Screenshot below of the new "SVD Hell" skin that you'll only be able to get through Season Pass 04:)
	
		And no, this is not the ONLY unique skin / content for the Season Pass 04. There is a lot more!
		
		https://i.imgur.com/2mesrh7.png
		
		 				There is also a dedicated key item (both for Survival and Open World) available in Season Pass 04. In this case, players can get the Season Pass 04 Key 7x for each Survival and Open World through the rewards.
		
		Players can use these keys to enter an exclusive Season Pass 04 zone that can only be entered by players with this particular key. In these areas players have a chance to find even more exclusive Season 04 Pass-only content. And yes, even have a chance on getting ANOTHER SVD Hell skin recipe.
		
		Risky? Yes. You'll have to venture through Colorado V2 and open the door, although since this is map based, you can also just go on your private server.
		Remember, you'll only receive 7 keys in total for both Survival and Open World each. You'll only have 7 tries as they key disappears from your inventory once the door is opens.

notes.title: Patch 3.3
notes.notes:
https://i.imgur.com/XCzfKJG.jpg

	 

	Dear Community,

(Original Post: https://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/8984-patch-33/)

	A lot of exciting stuff has happened in the previous two development weeks. We have worked on a lot, and have finished a lot of awesome new content and features. Main new features this patch offers is the random helicopter crash system, which will be available in both Open World and Survival. Next to that we are finally releasing the new 'slicer' creature which is a new type of super / boss zombie. Also this creature will be available in Open World and Survival. On top of all this a locked room / door system has been implemented into the game. This allows us to block off rooms with doors that need keys, or other items to be opened. These locked rooms are also available in both the Open World and Survival game-mode.

	But that's not all, next to everything mentioned above this patch has a lot more to offer. We have recently worked out and finished numerous ideas and this is just the tip of the ice berg. This patch is rolled out purely to not overflow the amount of work and changes we have made to the game. This means you can all expect another patch very soon again.

	We have a medieval event planned to be released very soon. A lot of awesome new, and amazing looking content has been implemented in to the game and with this event we plan to step up the game and make it an even more awesome event than any of the events we have done before.

	 

	Anyways, for now, let's jump into the patch notes:

	Overall Updates:

	GENERAL:
			Various new assets have been added to the game related to a future medieval themed event.				You can no longer create characters or clans with a name that contains more than 1 consecutive space between the letters.				Added a 'prefab spawn system'. A system like this allows us to create prefabs that we can randomly spawn either manually (event-based) or by the server. The first type we have developed for this is a random helicopter crash site. These can spawn in random areas on a server. Only one can be up at a time and the area is indicated on the minimap. The helicopter crash sites, their loot and spawn location varies per game-mode and map so we will be listing that under the separate game-mode section of these patch notes.
		
		https://i.imgur.com/PBR5Tq5.jpg
		 				Updated German localization.				Account experience rewards have been updated. Here is the list of account XP:									Complete any mission: 10 XP.										Contest a clan point: 18 XP.										Call in an airdrop: 25 XP.										Open an airdrop in Battle Royale: 5 XP.										Kill a Slicer: 25 XP.										Kill an Alien Super Zombie: 15 XP.										Kill a Toxic Super Zombie: 12 XP.										Kill a Super Zombie: 8 XP.										Learn any skin: 1 XP.										Play a Competitive game: 25 XP.										Every Battle Royale minute played: 5 XP.										Kill a player: 5 XP.										Kill a zombie: 1 XP.						
	GAMEPLAY:
			You can now see way points that are placed by other group members. They all automatically have it's own matching color assigned.				Removed the blur from radiation zones when wearing a gas mask. This so it's easier to generally see when being inside radiation zones and having a gas mask equipped.				Clan points now reward with SD or GD (depending on the game-mode) when being captured.				New type of player spawns have been added to all maps. These new type of spawns are so called 'beginner spawns' and are dedicated for beginning players / accounts. This way we can concentrate beginning players to only spawn in specific / more beginner friendly areas.				The cooldown on medical and consumable items has been reworked. Cool downs are now properly adjusted to the medical / consumable type where for example a bandage now has less cooldown than an antibiotic. (Antibiotics heal a lot more than a bandage and should therefor have a higher cooldown, but before this patch that was not the case.)	
	UI:
			The 'play game' screen has been reworked. Not only is the screen adjusted to the new style, but by reworking we have also made space for the 'quick play' button.
		
		https://i.imgur.com/6PAvh9W.png
		 				The mouse will no longer be 'locked' in to the game when in any of the game menus.				Fixed several UI bugs in the servers list selection screen.				Attachments are now rendered on the skin preview screen. (Ammo, sights, etc.)	
	MODELS:
			Created LODs for all the zombie "lay" models. (the dead zombies you see laying around in pretty much all maps.)	
	SECRET ROOMS:
	A new 'feature' has been added. We are now able to use doors in our maps. We are also able to lock them, where a certain item is needed for that door to be opened. There is some important features related to this system you should know:
			When a door is locked, you can still press "e" on it and it will indicate what it needs to be opened.				When opening a door, that needs any type of key, it will consume the key aka the key will dissapear from your inventory. The key is a one-time use item to open the locked door once.				Any door can always be opened from the inside of the room. There is a red button that you have to press from the inside to open it. No you can not log out in these rooms, if you do, your spawn will reset.				There is also normal doors, that are not locked and can be interacted with normally.	
	This resulted in us implementing the door system the following way: (The following goes for both the Survival and Open World game-mode)

	There is two types of rooms:
[olist]			Common Locked Room. Need "Common Key" to open. These "Common Rooms" contain rare loot.
		https://i.imgur.com/poujEYZ.png				Rare Locked Room. Need "Rare Key" to open. These "Rare Rooms" contain super rare loot.
		https://i.imgur.com/3Nh1mP4.png	[/olist]
	The idea with this new system is to create more alternative and interactive ways for players to loot and explore areas. This is just the start of something we plan on playing a prominent role in New Z. Keys are progression based, so the highest chance to obtain a rare key, is by finding it inside a locked room that needs a common key.

	As for now. Common keys have a chance to be dropped from a Slicer. Rare keys have a chance to be spawning inside a common room.

	VEHICLES:
			Fixed an issue when zombies would spawn in front of a car when driving at high speeds, causing it to crash	
	ZOMBIES:
			The new "Slicer" (Similar to a Super Zombie) has been finished. This means that after this patch this creature will be spawning in the worlds. Where and how it will spawn, depends on the map and the game-mode so we will be listing that under the separate game-mode section of these patch notes.
		
		The Slicer is a big creature that has a lot of health and is hard to kill. It can be compared to the Super Zombie although it is a lot stronger. The slicer is unique in a lot of ways. It's not only an entire new type of creature with it's own mesh, animations, sounds and AI. The slicer has 15.000 health and rewards 25 account XP per kill. You also gain character XP upon killing one,  for Survival you gain 700 XP, and for Open World 7000 XP.
		
		The AI part is as following:
		 									The Slicer will always return to it's original spawn location when not aggro'd by any player. When it reaches it's original spawn location it will start regenerating it's health.
				Note: The idea here is to keep it at all times aggro'd on you or another player. The zombie is smart, if you are on top of something where it can't hit or aggro on you, it will start moving towards it's original spawn location again. This is why it's recommended to do this with at least one more other player.										The slicer has a shield. The shield is active when the Slicer is idle on it's spawn area and not aggro'd on anything. To disable the shield you need to aggro it and draw it away from it's spawn area. The shield will get disabled you will be able to damage it.										A Slicer spawn is indicated on the minimap. Only one spawn can be up at a time. If no player is near the Slicer (within 100 meters) it will despawn. The slicer has a cooldown timer, so it will take some time before a new slicer spawns.
				
				https://i.imgur.com/DNJxkRW.jpg
				 									Improved performance drops caused by zombies when they die. (raggdoll)				Zombies will no longer 'stop' upon detecting sounds from an unreachable player that's for example firing a weapon.				Zombies inside a radiation zone are now slightly easier to kill.				The toxic super zombie now drops 5 items instead of 3. This goes for all game-modes.

	FIXES:
			Fixed a major issue related to particular skins having too much specular power causing multiple visual glitches especially for player playing on higher settings. One of the effects of this was where you'd have a skin that would annoyingly bright and blink all the time. (here is an example of one of the visual issues: https://gyazo.com/f89caa5e3b9c730df1b0cbfdd59a0694)				Fixed the muzzle texture of the MP5/10 SD Tech where it had a skinned muzzle attached on default.				Fixed the recipe icon of the QBZ-95 Tech skin.	
	REWORKS:

	ADDITIONS:
			Added a new spray: "300 FPS Spray".
		https://i.imgur.com/rW5f4bS.png				Added a new spray: "Can you catch? Spray".
		https://i.imgur.com/1q1QBqE.png				Added a new spray: "Energetic than ever Spray".

		https://i.imgur.com/HT2oZSP.png

			We have disabled the exchange missions for now since we are going to enable the in-game Survival Currency marketplace.				The Survival Marketplace is now enabled. Players can now buy items for Survival Dollars. The marketplace can only be accessed in safe zones through marketplace NPC's.				Added a wallet (Cash) system. This means that from now on Survival Dollars gathered will now drop on the ground and are an actual item that's in your inventory. To add this 'money' to your account you have to use the new ATM system. There is several things you should know about the new cash system:
		 									When you die, all cash you had on you will be dropped on the ground. This means that other players can kill you, and take the cash you collected that run. 										ATM's are in every Survival map. They are located in all safe zones and in all towns and cities that have a bank or post office. 										The safest way to transfer your collected cash to your account is by doing it in a safe zone, as you could be killed doing it in a normal town or city.										In an ATM you can also withdraw money out of your account. This means you can take out money and put it on your character.										ATM's that are located in a safe zone won't take a fee for any type of transaction. ATM's that are located outside of a safe zone will take a fee for any type of transaction. https://i.imgur.com/qeNP9ER.jpg

	Dear Community,

(Original Post: https://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/8930-patch-32/)

	It's time for another update and this time a lot more aimed towards beginning players where we have added tutorial screens, more translations and more language support over all. Next to all of this we are patching in the new "Tech" skins with the Tech Skinbox. We are also rolling out this update to patch in content for the upcoming Easter 2020 event. More information about that event will be released in the near future.

	 

	For now, let's get in to the patch notes.

	 

	Overall Updates:

	GENERAL:
			Added various new content for the upcoming Easter 2020 event. Easter secret spots have been added to all maps. Please note that once again these spots are already showing in the game but won't be spawning any loot until the Easter 2020 event starts.				All the beginner missions that activate when joining the beginner training map are now translated in all available languages.				The in-game chat font has been updated to a different one that supports more languages including Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Thai and more. There will no longer be weird block icons showing when using characters from a specific language. If you still experience issues with writing your language in the in-game chat please let us know so we can work on this.				The character name allowance has been improved as well. We now allow characters to be created again with a lot more characters and letters from specific languages.				The Steam friends system is now integrated in to the game. This means you can now see and invite any of your Steam friends from the game to come and play with you.				Added a tutorial slideshow for new players. This screen can be accessed by pressing F1 in either the main menu or in-game. There is separate screens for the different game-modes and there is separate screens for in the menu and in the game. We have also localized these screens although we are not 100% finished with the translations and all the screens yet. More will be added in future updates.	
	GAMEPLAY:
			Added an option to enable / disable the automatic equip of gear and attachments when picked up or attached.				Picking up a better helmet will no longer automatically switch the gas mask when a player is inside the radiation zone or when a night vision is enabled.	
	SERVERS:
			Support for Oceania servers has been added. This means this is now a new region added in the game. There is no servers running in this new region just yet but there will be a later specific announcement about this.	
	 

	Item & Skin Updates:

	UPDATES:
			Updated all Custom Guerilla Fallen Angel skins. We have reworked the wings just like we did on the Heavy Armor Fallen Angel skins. The wings look better, are in a better position and are more optimized.				Updated the skinbox icon for the Police Box. This box is legacy but the icon was never updated.				Updated the skinbox icon for the Halloween 2019 Box. This box is legacy but the icon was never updated.				Updated the skinbox icon for the Summer 2019 Box. This box is legacy but the icon was never updated.				Updated the skinbox icon for the Valentine 2020 Box. This box is legacy but the icon was never updated.				Updated the skinbox icon for the Winter 2019 Box. This box is legacy but the icon was never updated.				Updated the store icon and the recipe icon for the QBZ-95 Tech skin. This skin will also be added to the new Tech Skinbox.	
	FIXES:
			Fixed the Heavy Armor Fallen Angel Chrome texture. The skin should now be properly chrome again.				Fixed the Heavy Armor BR Champion. It is now better rigged around the character and should fit any character better.				Fixed the Heavy Armor Fallen Angel Purple skin. The wings are now chrome again instead of white glowing.				Fixed the Heavy Armor Fallen Angel Desion skin. The wings are now chrome red-ish again instead of white glowing.				Rank skins now also apply to Battle Royale team wins.	
	REWORKS:
			Reworked the store icon for the VSS Vintorez (sniper) & it's skinned variants.				Reworked the store icon for the VSS Compact & it's skinned variants.				Reworked the store icon for the Honey Badger & it's skinned variants.				Reworked the store icon for the QLB & it's skinned variants.				Reworked the store icon for the SVU & it's skinned variants.				Reworked the store icon for the Flashlight & it's skinned variants.				Reworked the store icon for the Hatchet & it's skinned variants.				Reworked the store icon for the Blaser & it's skinned variants.				Reworked the store icon for the AWP & it's skinned variants.				Reworked the store icon for the Bizon & it's skinned variants.				Reworked the store icon for the P90 & it's skinned variants.				Reworked the store icon for the MP5/10 SD & it's skinned variants.				Reworked the store icon for the B93r & it's skinned variants.	
	FURTHER WEAPON STATS REWORK:
	Continuing the guns rework, we have revisited prior changes we've made to SMGs and readjusted them to better serve their real purposes. 
	SMGs are made to be extremely powerful close combat weapons and they should not be strong at a high distance. The issue with their previous status is that, first of all, they had no pattern... Some were extremely strong at certain distances, while others were useless even at close range. Now, we've adjusted to make them at least a bit more logically similar (but not the same) as they all serve the same purpose. 
	Basically, we have adjusted damage, improved speed and spread while nerfing the damage distance on them. We also took into consideration each gun's fire-rate and clip size to make this fair. That way, they will adapt to your play style better and you will be inclined to use each one, depending on how you like playing (rushing and pre-firing, tap-shooting, waiting-and-shooting, spray-and-spray, etc...). 

	LMGs needed a rework as well, however this is very delicate. LMGs's current main purpose and use is for farming, especially for killing super/alien zombies so we had to tread carefully here. 
[olist]			We cannot lower their damage or it will affect their current main use, which we don't want to hinder. 				We also can't make it too precise as they are extremely powerful for automatic weapons, with very high damage. 				We shouldn't leave them stuck only for extremely close combat. 	[/olist]
	So with these three things in mind, we have added the Spread Variation System to it, where the more you shoot the more spread it has, with a fair limit to it, so it also doesn't go to the sky. 

	Future tweaks may occur on these weapons in the near future, but for now, enjoy their new stats and try them out!

	ADDITIONS:
			Added a new healing item: Toilet Paper. This item won't be available straight away but will be part of a future upcoming event. The toilet paper works just like a bandage, it has animations and can heal the player when being used.

		Note: The new Tech skins and the Tech Skinbox will be available in the in-game marketplace directly after this update.

			Fixed some texture issues related to concrete walls.

			Fixed a terrain issue in the north of area the city.

			Improved the Battle Royale matchmaking system for faster games aka less queue time.				Reworked the Battle Royale queue UI screen.				Added a new option / button for Battle Royale players that want to play solo in a group Battle Royale game. 	Dear Community,

(Original Post: https://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/8897-patch-31/)	 

	Here we are already at patch 3.1. We planned on releasing this update later, but due to some particular issues and improvements we have made to the game we decided to release the update earlier. We were also forced to roll out this update as soon as possible as there was a major issue related to the navigation regions for zombies. This caused not only corruption and crashes but also caused players to experience major performance issues and zombies behaving incorrectly.

	 

	Here's the notes for this patch:

	Overall Updates:

	GENERAL:
			Fixed a crash related to VOIP. (VOIP is the in-game voice system)				Fixed a client-sided memory leak.	
	OPTIONS:
			Added an option to adjust the sensitivity of weapon distance sounds. This option allows you to adjust the distance for weapon sounds (for example when you hear a weapon firing mostly).	
	GAMEPLAY:
			Gear will now also auto-update if you pick up a better version than the gear you are currently wearing. This also goes for helmets.				Swapping weapons will now remember attached attachments. Here is an example: https://i.gyazo.com/c85091043d2df73db08b3f1b6eca2f17.mp4				Adjusted the auto-update backpack feature where you can now pick up backpacks even if your backpack is full, it will just put the backpack in your inventory. As long as the backpack is bigger, it will still auto-equip that backpack.				Logging in to a server with a unskinned item will no longer un-attach attachments upon auto skinning to your favorite skin.				Fixed a bug where grenades and other throwable items would not go to your quick slots when picking them up.				Fixed a bug causing the airdrop plane to stutter instead of flying through the air smoothly.	
	MODELS:
			Fixed some texture/material related errors related to LOD versions of particular pine tree meshes.	
	VEHICLES:
			Fixed a texture issue related to the Tuk Tuk vehicle where the inside of the front glass had an incorrect texture.				Fixed an issue related to the newly added (not released yet) 'racer' vehicle. This vehicle is still work in progress but planned to be added soon.	
	ZOMBIES:
			The "Night Zombies" (which were work in progress) no longer spawn. These were never intended to spawn in the first place as it was still work in progress. You can recognize a "Night Zombie" because it has a very dark texture with glowing eyes. Night Zombies will be released when they're ready.				Fixed a bug causing zombies to run around (glitched) in a t-pose animation.				Fixed zombie aggro issues.				Fixed an issue related to zombies stacking up in groups causing huge performance drops.	
	 

	Item & Skin Updates:

	UPDATES:
			Updated all (6) Heavy Armor Fallen Angel skins. We have reworked the wings, and moved them to a better spot so instead of them being attached to the shoulders they are now attached to the back of the armor. This was requested by the community in huge amounts. We have also optimized these skins better.	
	FIXES:
			Fixed an issue related to a missing texture related to the AWP sniper rifle.				Fixed the Scimitar melee rotation in both FPS and TPS when holding this melee.	
	REWORKS:
			Reworked the Heavy Armor store icons and all it's skinned variants.	
	IMPROVEMENTS:
			Improved the inspect animation for previewing a karambit (melee) or any of it's skins.	
	 

	Open World Updates:

			Removed some of the player spawns in the south side of the map.	
	 

	Battle Royale Updates:

	GENERAL:
			Fixed a bug where sometimes players would get kicked while reviving a team mate.				Fixed a bug causing the auto selection of group Battle Royale games to not work correctly when in a party.

			Added radiation zones.

notes.title: Patch 3.0
notes.notes:
https://i.imgur.com/G5JSKDr.jpg

	Dear Community,

(Original Post: https://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/8867-patch-30/)

	Here we are at Patch 3.0. Now, you might wonder why we are continuing our patch series from 3 now instead of the usual 2 and that's because next to splitting the Battle Royale game-mode into it's own game we have also done major improvements to the original game; New Z. The biggest most major change actually happened 1 patch ago where we ported New Z to 64-bit. Since this was such a huge change and improvement for the game we aimed to separately release that update first in case of any potential issues.

	Everyone who hasn't read the previous patch notes where we ported the game to 64-bit we would really recommend to read these patch notes at: https://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/8800-patch-244/

We would also like to announce that Infestation: Battle Royale is officially released on Steam now! Go check it out here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1240290/Infestation_Battle_Royale/

https://i.imgur.com/RnWnALV.jpg

	Before we jump in to the patch notes of patch 3.0 we would recommend you all the watch the new dev-blog video from Fred where he goes over some of the points for the patch.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mptE5sNWuSk	

	Now, make sure to like and comment on the video while you're at it! Let's jump into the actual patch notes.

	 

	Overall Updates:

	GENERAL:
			Various new content has been added for the new upcoming Season Pass #3. For more information about the season pass and it's content we recommend you all to check the content in-game after this update. We have added a lot of exciting and cool rewards so it's definitively worth to check this out! The new Season Pass #3 will be available for purchase directly after this update. Something new this season pass is that you can also be rewarded with any of the newly added in-game currencies.				Fixed particular issues related to the navigation mesh system. (controls where zombies can walk and where not etc.)				Fixed an error related to the Filipino localization which was causing the game to crash.				Fixed a shadow issue related to the pine tree models in Colorado when lighting quality was set on ultra.				Fixed a bug related to the account level system where a silver border would show for levels 400-410 even though it is supposed to be gold here.				Fixed a game crash that happened when changing the game from or to full screen or when changing resolution settings.				Fixed a visual graphics bug related to the SSAO setting along with the setting presets.				Fixed a bug causing the menu buttons to bug after using the bus or clan transport system in game.				Fixed a rare crash related to airdrops that had landed while a player was joining a server.				Fixed a game freeze related to zombies updating and multi-threading in 64-bit.				Fixed a bug causing your body to show invisible on the death screen when dieing in first-person.				Fixed a bug that caused the game to crash when changing language in the server. This bug also caused the "hold E" menu to pop up and glitch.				Fixed various UI visual bugs related to the in-game menu.				Fixed a terrain issue for far away textures.				Added a new slider option for the render sharpness. This controls the render bias. Here is an example: https://i.gyazo.com/1b8724ab4b62eb6d941f33735221ab37.mp4				Added back the option presets due to requests of the community. This means the presets; potato, low, medium, high and ultra are back. You can now also change individual settings after selecting an option preset without the preset switching.				Added a skinbox opening animation. When opening a skinbox an animation will now play where you can visually see how close you were to getting that super rare skin! If you want to see how it looks we recommend you to watch the dev-blog video mentioned at the start of these patch notes.				Added a system that will detect if the player is stuck in the water to aid release.				Added a tips system that will help new players to get started with the game. You can disable tips in the game settings.				Re-generated navigation mesh in 64-bit. This for better optimizations and to improve stability.				Improved some of the level leading features to be multi-threaded for faster loading speed.	
	GAMEPLAY:
			Improved the bus stop camera animation.				Improved the reputation icons in the in-game HUD that you see when aiming at other players. The icons will no longer block the visibility of the level border on the character tags.				Improved the airdrop animations. Should be a lot smoother now for both the falling crate and the plane.				Attachments will now automatically attach to your weapon(s) when picking an attachment up that's supported by the weapon. For example: if you have no attachments attached to your M16, and you pick up a kobra sight, the kobra sight will automatically attach to your M16.				Attachments will attempt to automatically attach to your compatible weapon(s) upon joining a server in both Open World and Survival. This means that if you join a server with an M16 and a kobra sight in your backpack, the kobra sight will be attached for you when successfully joined the server.				Attaching and removing any attachment from any weapon will now correctly be synced with the hand animations.				Picking up a backpack that has bigger inventory size than the backpack you are currently wearing will automatically switch your backpack to that one. For example: if you have a small backpack equipped and you find a large backpack, when you pick it up the large backpack will automatically be equipped.				Quick slots will be "reserved" for consumables until the rest of the backpack can no longer hold more items. What happened before was that even weapons went in to the players' quick slots even though the weapon can not be used when being put in a quick slot.				Optimized the HUD. Frames no longer drop when running or moving the camera around.				The in-game minimap (M) will now update live with your position even when you are moving yourself.				Using fast travel (bus or clan) will no longer break the depth of field.	
	VEHICLES:
			Fixed a bug causing players to fly up in to the air or to be teleported to a random position when leaving a vehicle.				Reworked the camera system for the vehicles: improved the car passenger(s) camera smoothing and the vehicle camera no longer rotates when opening the in-game menu.				You can now slightly control a vehicle while being air-borne. This allows players to land properly and control the vehicle while being in the air.				Added a feature that allows players to un stuck their vehicle by rolling and moving the vehicle slightly using the 'WASD' keys when the vehicle is stuck in or on something.				Stats of the vehicles have been reworked with focus on stability. You should notice a great improvement in drivability.	
	LAUNCHER:
			Our launcher now uses https for improved security.	
	 

	Item & Skin Updates:

	ADDITIONS:
			Added the M9 Helmet Blue as a skin.				Added the M9 Helmet Desert as a skin.				Added the M9 Helmet Desert Goggles as a skin.				Added the M9 Helmet Green as a skin.				Added the M9 Helmet Urban Goggles as a skin.				Added the M9 Helmet Forest as a skin.				Added the M9 Helmet Forest Goggles as a skin.				Added the M9 Helmet Camo as a skin.				Added the M9 Helmet Sand as a skin.
		 				With the M9 helmet variants being converted to skins there is a couple of things you guys should know. Every account that has logged in un till 1 months ago, will receive all the "default" m9 helmet skins learned.
		 				New skins have been added to the Pink Graffiti collection! This includes: IBA Pink Graffiti, MTV Pink Graffiti, M. Style Helmet Heavy Pink Graffiti, IMI Tar-21 Pink Graffiti, M4A1 Pink Graffiti, M4 Semi Pink Graffiti, M4 Pink Graffiti, M16 Pink Graffiti, Mosin Nagant Pink Graffiti, MP7 Pink Graffiti, UZI Pink Graffiti. All these news skins are added to the currently available Pink Graffiti skinbox.
		 				New skins have been added to the Hynx and Hynx v2 collection! This includes: Famas Hynx v2, AK-74M Hynx v2, M16 Hynx, MP5/10 Hynx, FN P90 Hynx v2, AKS-74U Hynx, G36 Hynx, IBA Hynx, MTV Hynx v2, M9 Helmet Hynx, M9 Helmet Hynx v2, M. Style Helmet Hynx, M. Style Helmet Hynx v2. All these new skins are added to the currently available Hynx skinbox.	
	UPDATES:
			Updated the item name of the "M9 Helmet Black" to "M9 Helmet Basic". This to fit the conversion to skins for the other M9 helmets.	
	FIXES:
			Fixed the Mauser SP66 Pink Graffiti skin glow map. This weapon skin now glows as it should be.				Fixed the dropped model for the Vindicator Skinbox that was showing the Valentine skinbox when being dropped on the ground.	
	REWORKS:
			Reworked the store icon for the M. Style Helmet Heavy. Also reworked it's skinned variants.	
	IMPROVEMENTS:
			Improved the AA-12 Pink Graffiti. The iron sight is now skinned as well.				Added a skinned iron sight for the AA-12 Halloween.				Added a skinned iron sight for the AA-12 Winter.				Added a skinned iron sight for the AA-12 Vindicator.	
	 

	Open World Updates:

	COLORADO V2 (OW):
			Fixed a flying clan territory flag at the NATO base.				Fixed a player spawn that was under the terrain.	
	COLORADO V1:
			Optimized the zombie spawns around the airport.	
	 

	Survival Updates:

	GENERAL:
			Added a dedicated currency to the Survival game-mode. This is done based on the huge demand from the community. For now the in-game store won't have any items available for this currency (yet) except for the skin boxes that are available in the Open World for Game Dollars. This means that dedicated ONLY Survival players can now farm a similar free currency and have the ability to use this free currency to buy particular items just like how it has been in the Open World game-mode. We are also able to control the rate so for future events we are able to do double currency periods.				Players can now trade Survival Dollars with other players through the trading menu just like how it is with Game Dollars in the Open World game-mode.	
	COLORADO V1:
			Optimized the zombie spawns around the airport.	
	 

	Battle Royale Updates:

	GENERAL:

	In Patch 3.0 Battle Royale will be separated from the original Infestation: The New Z. This means players can no longer play the Battle Royale game-mode directly from the original game. A new separated variant of the game will be launched on March 4, 2020 aka tomorrow.

	Accounts including the skins, GC, experience and more are made global meaning you can use the same account with the same skins and currencies for both games. We recommend every player that would like more information about the Battle Royale release to visit the following links:
			Steam page of Infestation: Battle Royale: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1240290/Infestation_Battle_Royale/				Forum announcement with more information: https://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/8827-infestation-battle-royale-free-to-play-coming-on-steam-march-4th/				We will save the original all-time Battle Royale leaderboards and reward top players in upcoming patch instead.	
	With Battle Royale turning in to it's "own game" we have made a lot of tweaks and adjustments.
			Added a dedicated currency to the Battle Royale game-mode. This is done based on the huge demand from the community. For now the in-game store won't have any items available for this currency (yet) except for the skin boxes that are available in the Open World for Game Dollars. This means that dedicated ONLY Battle Royale players can now farm a similar free currency and have the ability to use this free currency to buy particular items just like how it has been in the Open World game-mode. We are also able to control the rate so for future events we are able to do double currency periods.				Battle Royale now has region selection. Players are now able to choose what region to queue in when choosing a map to queue on in the pre-queue screen in the main menu.				You can now see how many players are currently playing a particular Battle Royale map per region in the pre-queue screen.				The airdrop and safe zone icon / indicators have been added to the HUD radar. (The HUD radar is the radar on the top of the screen in Battle Royale that indicates what is north, south, east, west, etc.)				Sprinting speeds has slightly been increased in the Battle Royale game-mode to fasten the overall gameplay experience.	
	LOOT:
			Major changes have been made to the loot in the Battle Royale game-mode. A lot more items that are available in the game are now also available in Battle Royale. Of course all with controlled rarities. High end gear such as a heavy armor or a sniper are still only available from radiation zones or airdrops.
		
		For further feedback about the loot in Battle Royale we would like to invite all of you to let us know here: https://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/5380-loot-battle-royale/	
	COLORADO:
			Colorado is now available as a Battle Royale map! We have made a custom variant of the known Colorado map fit for Battle Royale. With this initial addition the map and gameplay style varies a bit from other Battle Royale maps. These are noticeable changes:									Loot mainly spawns inside houses and buildings.										Vehicles are available and can spawn anywhere around the map.										Original safe zones have been turned in to radiation zones. You will need a gas mask to enter a radiation area. Gas masks spawn pretty much anywhere around a radiation area.						
	ARENA:
			Added more end-zones. Meaning, there is now a bigger variety of where the final safe zone of the Battle Royale game can be.				Fixed the overall lighting.	
	TROPICO:
			Added more end-zones. Meaning, there is now a bigger variety of where the final safe zone of the Battle Royale game can be.				Vehicles are available and can spawn anywhere around the map.				Fixed the overall lighting.	
	ARIZONA V2:
			Added more end-zones. Meaning, there is now a bigger variety of where the final safe zone of the Battle Royale game can be.				Fixed the overall lighting.	
	 

	Competitive Updates:

	GENERAL:
			Added a dedicated currency to the Competitive game-mode. This is done based on the huge demand from the community. For now the in-game store won't have any items available for this currency (yet) except for the skin boxes that are available in the Open World for Game Dollars. This means that dedicated ONLY Competitive players can now farm a similar free currency and have the ability to use this free currency to buy particular items just like how it has been in the Open World game-mode. We are also able to control the rate so for future events we are able to do double currency periods.	
	 

	Estimated patch size: Around 440 mb.

	Patch ETA: Patch will roll out at this moment.

	Estimated downtime: Around 1-2 hours. It's a big one.

	Pre-patch notes might be changed if we need to fix / add something.

	 

	Once again thank you for your great support! Want to support us even more? Make sure to share these patch notes with your friends and followers!

	For any feedback about the game or this patch please let us know at http://playnewz.com/feedback

	If you'd like to share suggestions and ideas you have for the game please let us know at: https://suggest.playnewz.com/

	To stay updated regarding the patch and server downtime please follow us on our social media:
	Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Infestation.NewZ/
	Twitter: https://twitter.com/infestationnewz
	Discord: https://discordapp.com/invite/thenewz
	Youtube: http://www.youtube.com/c/InfestationTheNewZOfficial

	 

	Best Regards,

	 

	// Fredaikis

notes.notes:
https://i.imgur.com/H65rACS.jpg

	 

	Dear Community,

(Original Post: http://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/8800-patch-244/)	 

	A new patch is rolling out as we speak with some major improvements and additions for the game. We have done a lot of work related to performance, improving loading speeds, fixing crashes and re-styled parts of the UI.

	We hope you like this update. Here are the notes:

	 

	Overall Updates:

	GENERAL:
			Fixed some spelling mistakes in the UI related to renaming a character in the main menu.				Fixed a major server bug causing the server to lagg when reaching a high amount of players.				Our game servers now also run in 64-bit for improved performance and stability.				Majorly improved the "loading game data" stage. This happens every time a player enters the main menu of the game. It is a lot faster now as we have made huge improvements to the loading speed of this process.				Also improved the game loading time when a player loads into a server. It is a lot faster now to join a server and play.				Fixed some crashes related to changing the resolution or the when using the full screen option.				Fixed a crash related to using sprays.				Fixed a crash that happened when players tried starting their game with corrupted key bind settings.				Fixed 2 different crashes related to the vehicle system.				Fixed a bug causing the servers located in Hong Kong to show as a US server in the "My Servers" menu in the main menu.				Daily rewards and other notifications will now show separated per game-mode. This is because the daily rewards are now separated per game-mode as we have now added a daily reward system for the Survival game-mode as well.				The trading lounge has been updated back to the original lounge.	
	GAMEPLAY:
			Players no longer take damage when exiting a vehicle.	
	LAUNCHER:
			The launcher will now set the game on default to 64-bit. You can still use the 32-bit version of the game.				The launcher has been update to 60 FPS. (instead of 30)				For those who missed it: we have updated our game launcher to a new style. Here is a preview:
		
		https://i.imgur.com/LIiojV9.png	
	UI:
			The UI of the game has been updated to 60 FPS. (instead of 30) This will finally make the UI feel smooth especially when for example moving items.				General UI style has been updated trough out the entire main menu.	
	REWORKED OPTIONS UI:

	In this patch we have reworked the options UI. The old options UI was very outdated and limited us to add new features and next to that also was very inconvenient to use. The whole style and basic lay out has been reworked.

	https://i.imgur.com/JMTC4hN.jpg

	Further improvements and options we have added next to reworking the UI are:
			Added settings to change the default audio device. (Before players were not able to do this)				Added an option to control anisotropy quality.				Added an option to control the item color highlight setting in the main menu options UI as well.				The "Overall Quality Option" does no longer override all the settings. This allows players to for example set their game to "HIGH" as overall quality but theyll still be able to change settings independently. (Before this was not possible)				Players can now change pretty much all their settings inside the game. (Before they had to log out and do that in the main menu) There are some exceptions so not every single setting is available the in-game options UI.	
	https://i.imgur.com/a2ZEf2o.jpg

	WINTER 2019-2020 EVENT:

	The major Winter 2019-2020 event is now over. Winter secret spots are removed from the maps, the item spawns related to the Winter event have been disabled and the Winter 2019 Box is no longer available. The staff craft (2) missions / trade-ins in Survival are still available to do but will be removed in the patch after this. If you have crystals left, trade them in so you can get your final staffs because this will be disabled as well soon.

Added dropped skin recipe model variants for the Alien skin recipes.				Added dropped skin recipe model variants for the Modern Black skin recipes.	
	FIXES:
			Fixed an error related to the scope for the SVD Winter Camo skin.	
	ASSAULT RIFLES REWORK:

	The AR Rework is finally here and as we've shown on our DevBlog last month, we aimed to make ARs a feasible option in PVP again. We have pretty much looked at each of the ARs individually and gave them a very special attention, which is something they really required. All the ARs have been changed in some way and some more than others. Though we won't go into much details on this as this is something for you guys to find on your own, you will notice that some guns will server specific purposes better than others, but they should all be pretty balanced out. Some of these ARs were also put as a second thought to players and they are now a very good option for PVP, depending on your style. Rather than focusing only on the main guns, we've made these changes to make them make more sense as well. For example, lighter guns will have a greater recoil while having a good speed for close encounters. Some others should be good enough to punish sniper users who miss too many shots. We went through a period of testing with some players and partners and using the feedback, adjusted them accordingly. We may make small adjustments to them later on but for now we are all (including the players who were part of the testing process) very happy with this balance. They are better than they were, but they are not extremely overpowered. We would also like to hear your feedback on these changes, as they will not only affect the PVP players but also PVE as they'll be able to farm zombies in a better way.

	You can find further information about the AR rework development here (also for feedback): http://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/8796-ar-rework/

notes.title: Patch 2.42
notes.notes:
https://i.imgur.com/bFdaMAm.jpg

	Dear Community,

	 

	A smaller patch to fix some issues, do some improvements and to disable the Christmas 2019 content. Quick note here: the Christmas 2019 event and content is disabled meaning that the Christmas trees are gone, Christmas loot is no longer spawning etc. although the major Winter event is still active and running.

	Now, in this update we are also introducing a smaller feature called the Waypoint System.

	We are working very hard on a bigger patch for 2.43 but for now this update was mandatory to be rolled out.

	 

	Enjoy!

	 

	Overall Updates:

	GENERAL:
			Removed all the Christmas content from the maps. Christmas 2019 event is fully disabled now.				Fixed an issue related to trading game dollars where when players traded over 2.1 billion game dollars the game dollars number would show incorrect or glitch after trading.				Fixed / improved overall server stability and connection.				Fixed an issue causing the report message box to stay open and bug your game after you revive yourself.				Fixed backpack name text being too large for it's container. Sometimes the text wouldn't properly resize when it was too long.				Increased the clan territory transport spawn protection from 5 to 10 seconds. 	
	TAUNTS:
			Added a new taunt: "Dance V1".
[previewyoutube=G1g1eZqT5EI;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]










	WAYPOINT SYSTEM:
			Added a new system: The Waypoint System. Using this system players can mark a location on their minimap. This location will only show for yourself.
